The '''Fogger Smoke Generator''' was a device installed on ground vehicles, [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeders]], or [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] to create a thick [[Color/Legends|black]] or gray smoke behind the vehicle. It was produced by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] and cost 2,750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="DC" />
